items.coder_A: hP1A8 is described as a vaccine adjuvant (immune agonist peptide) given with a tumour lysate vaccine; whether it counts as a pharmacological candidate or as part of the excluded vaccine intervention needs adjudication.
items.reason: hP1A8 is described as 'a new adjuvant CD200 activation receptor ligand' given 'in combination with imiquimod and the GBM6-AD vaccine'; R4 treats vaccine adjuvants as part of the excluded therapy. Its own arm and MTD outcome ('MTD of hP1A8 when administered with imiquimod and GBM6-AD') test it as an adjuvant, not as an antitumour agent in its own right.
